description: This file contains controller functions for managing tools via HTTP requests, including create, delete, retrieve, and update operations, utilizing express request/response objects and a tools service.

methods.name: createTool
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to create a new tool, validating request body and user context, then calling the tools service.

methods.name: deleteTool
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to delete a tool by ID, validating parameters and user context, then calling the tools service.

methods.name: getAllTools
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to retrieve all tools with pagination, calling the tools service.

methods.name: getToolById
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to retrieve a specific tool by ID, validating parameters and user context, then calling the tools service.

methods.name: updateTool
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to update a tool by ID, validating request data and user context, then calling the tools service.
